answer: By capping each peer's relay fanout and rate-limiting gossip propagation, an agent economy treats every identity as a scarce routing slot, so a sybil flood cannot reach the mesh zenith without exhausting per-peer budgets. Honest agents act as a shared oasis of verified stake, while any raven-like duplicate identity is throttled at ingress and down-scored by Byzantine penalization. Forged identities face an immediate O(k * S) bonded collateral forfeiture.
